questions.stem: An infant was administered chloramphenicol and after 8 days of treatment, the infant developed a sudden drop in blood pressure and the nails turned grey. A diagnosis of grey baby syndrome was made. Chloramphenicol gets metabolized by which of the following reaction?
questions.solutionHtml:
Glucuronide conjugation

Essentials Of Medical Pharmacology, By KD Tripathi, 8th Edition, Page Number: 31

questions.stem: A 30-year-old male with bronchial asthma was treated with theophylline to dilate the bronchus and relieve the symptoms. Which enzyme metabolizes the theophylline?
questions.solutionHtml:
CYP1A1/2

Essentials Of Medical Pharmacology, By KD Tripathi, 8th Edition, Page Number:30

questions.stem: A 30-year-old male took 20 tablets of paracetamol and came to the emergency. The physician decides to start an antidote for this patient. Which of the following is an antidote for paracetamol poisoning?
questions.solutionHtml:
N-acetyl cysteine
